notes: Effective policy is deny-by-default until the Product Owner approves policyProposal.
Developer Guidelines: services must be able to delete content a user asked to delete.
atproto account spec: content of deleted/deactivated accounts should not be redistributed.
No published restriction found on storing public posts, derived metrics or commercial use (absence of a rule is not a permission).

conditions: Re-check stored posts/accounts at least every refreshDays; delete records whose author deleted them or whose account is deactivated/taken down.
Store public post metadata and counts only; no media files; comment text not stored.
Exports for internal research only, always with source URLs.

notes: AppView limits not published ("generous"); PDS 3000 req/5 min/IP; createSession 30/5 min and 300/day per account.
Observed: no HTTP 429 during PoC runs.

credentialsOptional: BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER + BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD (enables search pagination via the authenticated path)
limitations: Unauthenticated searchPosts: page 1 only (<=100 results); requests with a cursor return HTTP 403 (observed 2026-11-26).
searchActors has no language/region filter and returns no follower counts (enrich with getProfile).
listComments: top-level replies only, no pagination.
record.createdAt is author-supplied and can be backdated; indexedAt is server time.
